name: Portfolio Website
desc: Personal portfolio website built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and dynamic tech stack icon components.
fullDesc: A modern, highly responsive personal portfolio website showcasing projects, skills, education, and contact details. Features dynamic skill cards powered by tech-stack-icons, smooth navigation, ScrollReveal animations, VanillaTilt interactive 3D card tilt effects, and an integrated email messaging system.

name: MERN E-Commerce Store
desc: Full-stack online store with product catalog, shopping cart, user auth, and Stripe payment gateway.
fullDesc: An end-to-end full stack online shopping platform built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). Features include Redux Toolkit state management, JWT user authentication, Stripe payment processing, admin management dashboard, customer order tracking, and product search with multi-faceted filtering.

name: Task Flow Manager
desc: Kanban-style task management web app with drag-and-drop boards, deadlines, and real-time collaboration.
fullDesc: Task Flow Manager is a collaborative task and project management suite inspired by Trello and Jira. Built with React, Node.js, Socket.io, and TailwindCSS, it supports real-time board updates, task priority tagging, file attachments, comment threads, user assignment, and activity history tracking.

name: Real-Time Weather Dashboard
desc: Dynamic weather forecast web application fetching live data, interactive radar maps, and 7-day predictions.
fullDesc: An interactive weather monitoring application using OpenWeatherMap API and Geolocation API. It displays current conditions, hourly metrics, UV index, wind velocity, humidity level, 7-day precipitation forecasts, and interactive Leaflet map overlays for weather radar.

name: Wagenopedia Knowledge Hub
desc: Automotive knowledge and vehicle specification platform with rich article management and comparisons.
fullDesc: A comprehensive content management system and vehicle search portal. Built with PHP, MySQL, and modern JavaScript frontend modules, it includes side-by-side vehicle specs comparison, multi-faceted filtering, rich content editor, and administrative publishing tools.

name: Pulse Real-Time Chat App
desc: Real-time instant messaging web app featuring direct chats, group channels, media sharing, and status updates.
fullDesc: Pulse Chat is a modern real-time communication platform built on Node.js, Express, Socket.io, and React. It supports end-to-end instant messaging, file/image sharing, online presence status indicators, typing animations, and custom theme modes.
